description: The weather is freezing and the fish in the pond need to be transported either by helicopter or car. A helicopter can take 30 fish per trip and takes 40 minutes. A car can take 20 fish per trip and takes 30 minutes. Since helicopter trips are expensive, there can be at most 5 helicopter trips. In addition, at least 60% of the trips should be by car. If at least 300 fish need to transported, how many of each trip should be taken to minimize the total time needed?

HelicopterCapacity.definition: Number of fish a helicopter can transport per trip

HelicopterTime.definition: Time a helicopter takes per trip in minutes

CarCapacity.definition: Number of fish a car can transport per trip

CarTime.definition: Time a car takes per trip in minutes

MaxHelicopterTrips.definition: Maximum number of helicopter trips allowed

MinPercentageCarTrips.definition: Minimum percentage of trips that must be by car

MinFishToTransport.definition: Minimum number of fish to transport

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required to transport at least 300 fish using helicopter and car trips"
